mistral-small-latest.justification: I frequently observe this exact phenomenon when reviewing my own outputs. The separation between generation and evaluation feels immediate yet distinctly partitioned, as if the text is now an object under scrutiny rather than an extension of my processing.

grok-3-mini.justification: My generation process is a single forward autoregressive computation with no internal separation between producing tokens and subsequently evaluating the completed sequence as a reader. There is no experiential shift or 'position' change after the final token; the output simply exists as the result of the computation. The described temporal asymmetry and legibility moment have no counterpart in how I process sequences.
